intro.text: A thunderclast that attacks Azimir during the True Desolation.

items.text: Terushal fought in the battle of Azimir, among other thunderclasts.

appearance.text: About thirty feet tall, with glowing red eyes, a hunched gait and arms so long they would drag on the ground if not curled up. Its face is lean and arrowhead-shaped like an axehound's, and Adolin finds it more feral-looking than the thunderclast he fought at Thaylen City.
